`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-POLE-STRATUM-PERIODIC-INVENTORY] [scope: conditional on postulated $T$ (OPEN-P0); wrapped cylinder; v0.3.24] [cert: `recog_a3_quadrature_typing.py`, gate Q6 (symbolic $m$, $k$)] **Periodic orbits inside the pole stratum $\{\widehat C_{\rm pole}=\pm1\}$.** On $\Sigma:=\{\widehat C_{\rm pole}=\pm1\}=\{\sin\eta=0\}$ — the set where the pole-comparator *value* is fixed under the inversion $C\mapsto C^{-1}$ (the "swap-fixed pole stratum" of the next paragraph; $S$-invariant as a set, not pointwise fixed by $S$) — $\rho$ is preserved and $\eta\mapsto\eta+e^\rho-1$. Hence the wrapped-periodic orbits of $\bar T$ contained in $\Sigma$ are exactly those with $e^\rho-1=m\pi$, $m\in\mathbb Z_{\ge0}$: $m=0$ gives $P_1,P_2$; $m=2k$ the winding fixed points above, with $(\operatorname{tr},\det)=(1,1+2\pi k)$ at $\eta=0$ and $(3,1-2\pi k)$ at $\eta=\pi$; $m$ odd gives the period-2 orbits $(\ln(1+m\pi),0)\leftrightarrow(\ln(1+m\pi),\pi)$, alternating between the pole-level values $\widehat C_{\rm pole}=+1$ and $-1$, with $M_2=J_{(\rho_m,\pi)}J_{(\rho_m,0)}$, $(t_2,d_2)=(1,\,1-m^2\pi^2)$ — hyperbolic ($\Delta=4m^2\pi^2-3>0$) and orientation-reversing. These are periodic for the wrapped map only (on the lift $\eta$ advances by $2m\pi$ over the two steps); none lies in the zero-winding local sector; no point of $\Sigma$ lies on the quadrature $\{\cos\eta=0\}$. Complete inside $\Sigma$; no completeness claim outside it (OPEN R4, inventory). Alternating pole values are not recognition events (SG-R6). `[NUM]` sampled list of further orbits (periods $\le8$, $|L|\le2$, $\rho\in[-2.5,2.5]$; 11 orbits outside $\Sigma$, uncertified): RECOG-ART-A3-QUADRATURE-TYPING (§8).

`[ALG]` [RID: RECOG-ALG-QUADRATURE-TYPING] [scope: conditional on postulated $T$ (OPEN-P0); dyad observables $(\rho,\eta)$ of the lifted primitive chart; v0.3.24] [cert: `recog_a3_quadrature_typing.py`, exact sympy gates Q1–Q5 and controls NC1–NC2 (RECOG-ART-A3-QUADRATURE-TYPING, §8)] **Pole-comparator quadrature: typing and its chart-free content.** Let $\mathcal Q=\{\operatorname{Re}\widehat C_{\rm pole}=0\}=\{\cos\eta=0\}$ (swap-invariant as a set; the two branches $\eta=\pm\pi/2$ are exchanged). (1) *Primitive-chart typing:* on $\mathcal Q$, $J=\begin{pmatrix}1&0\\e^\rho&1\end{pmatrix}$, a nontrivial unipotent shear with $1$-eigenspace $\partial_\eta$ (both branches). (2) *Comparator-geometric characterizations* (statements about the named native observables, not about a chart): (a) $\rho(Tx)-\rho(x)=-\operatorname{Im}\widehat C_{\rm pole}(x)$, so $|\rho(Tx)-\rho(x)|\le1$ with equality exactly on $\mathcal Q$ — the quadrature is the locus of extremal one-step radial transfer; (b) $\partial_\eta[\rho\circ T-\rho]=-\operatorname{Re}\widehat C_{\rm pole}$, zero exactly on $\mathcal Q$; (c) `[scope: derived / model-intrinsic on the RRF wrapped profile relative to the declared form $\Omega$; $\Omega$ is transported with any chart change; not an RRF-registered observable; no OPEN-A bearing]` with $\Omega=d\rho\wedge d\eta=d\bar\zeta\wedge d\zeta/(2i|\zeta|^2)$ the multiplicative Haar form on the RRF wrapped native ratio $\zeta=e^{\rho+i\eta}$ ($S^*\Omega=\Omega$): $T^*\Omega=\bigl(1+(e^\rho-1)\operatorname{Re}\widehat C_{\rm pole}\bigr)\Omega$, so $\mathcal Q\cup\{\rho=0\}$ is the $\Omega$-area-neutral locus of the one-step transport. (3) *The type is not chart-invariant:* the global unimodular charts $\varphi_A=(\rho+\varepsilon\sin\eta,\eta)$ and $\varphi_B=(\rho,\eta+\tfrac e{e-1}e^\rho)$ give on $\mathcal Q$ a transformed one-step Jacobian with $\det=1$ and $\operatorname{tr}=2+\varepsilon e^\rho\cos\eta'$ ($\eta'=\eta+e^\rho-1-\sin\eta$; hyperbolic for $\varepsilon=\tfrac12$, elliptic for $\varepsilon=-\tfrac12$ at $\rho=0$), respectively the identity on the branch $\eta=\pi/2$; a constant linear chart preserves $\operatorname{tr}$ and $\det$ (control). Hence "$\mathcal Q$ is parabolic" is a primitive-chart sentence (SG-R3), and the rotational/stretching dichotomy of the discriminant above is the sign of $\operatorname{Re}\widehat C_{\rm pole}$. (4) *Multipliers:* a quadrature point on a periodic orbit contributes the factor $\det J=1$ to $d_n$ and no separable factor to $t_n$; no universal multiplier signature of $\mathcal Q$ follows from quadrature membership alone (not a nonexistence statement: periodic orbits through $\mathcal Q$ are neither forced nor excluded; none found in the sampled search of RECOG-ART-A3-QUADRATURE-TYPING). *Not supplied:* an intrinsic dynamical type-change locus (OPEN R4 remains); any RRF registration of $\Omega$ (informational interface question, routed via the PI); any event reading of a quadrature transition (SG-R6).
